Install on your phone

Already using our direct APK? Install this update over your existing copy without uninstalling it. That keeps your saved TVs and lets Roomote carry over the last-used pairing when its identity can be confirmed.

  1. Open this page on your Android phone and tap Download Roomote APK.
  2. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install this app, then tap Install. You can turn that permission off again afterward.
  3. Open Roomote. Keep your phone and TV on the same reachable Wi-Fi network, with the TV switched on.
  4. For a new TV, tap the TV icon, choose your TV, and enter the six-character code shown on the TV. Existing users can let Roomote reconnect to their last-used TV.

The TV must support Android TV Remote Service v2. Discovery and supported buttons depend on your TV and network. A parent or guardian can help with installation and pairing.

A new IP, the same TV

Roomote now remembers a saved TV independently of its IP address. When your router assigns a new address, reopening the app starts a search of up to 30 seconds and checks that it has found the same paired TV.

If your network blocks discovery, open TV settings for the saved TV and choose Update address. Enter its current IP to reconnect using the existing pairing.

Upgrading from an older version keeps your saved TV entries. TVs other than the last-used one need one fresh pairing; the last-used TV may also need it if its old identity cannot be confirmed. After that, a normal IP change does not require another code. A reset TV authorization can still require pairing again.

Give it a try

Try navigation, volume, playback and reconnecting after closing the app. If your TV's address changes, tell us whether it reconnects without pairing again. Include your phone model, TV model, and which buttons worked at santu0002@gmail.com. Please leave out pairing codes and private information.

Read the setup and troubleshooting guide.

Moving to Google Play later

This test copy and the Google Play version use different signing certificates. To switch, uninstall this copy before installing from Google Play. Uninstalling clears saved TVs, so you will need to pair again.

Updates to this direct download are installed manually. The website will provide the Play link once the public release is available.
